title: NA60034: Safety And Maritime Regulations
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

IMO Regulations for safety; ILLC, SOLAS etc. - Rules for bulk Carriers-Grain
loading - Rules for liquid cargo carriers - double hull tanks, segregation of
tanks, tank- cleaning, special equipment; Rules of carriage of chemicals at
sea; Rules for fire fighting appliance, life saving appliances, light and
general signals; Rules of prevention of collision at sea; Ballast water
management- Structural Safety and Role of Classification Societies; Safety
Management and ISM certification
